title: Crop Fields for Austria
description: Annual crop field boundary polygons for Austria (2020–2024), derived from the INVEKOS integrated administration and control system used to process Common Agricultural Policy subsidy declarations. Each record is a single-crop, single-management field with crop type, area, and determination date.
